title: Deceleration without identification: testing a power-law trend in Bitcoin prices under persistent noise
abstract: arXiv:2611.13962v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Plotted against time since its first block on logarithmic axes, the price of Bitcoin lies close to a straight line, and a power law in time has been proposed as its long-run trend. A good fit is weak evidence: when deviations from a trend are as persistent as a random walk, regressions on time find trends and high $R^2$ where none exist. We first bound what fifteen years of weekly prices can reveal, then test only what is answerable. Using a few low-frequency averages, invariant to the noise scale and calibrated over a declared family of persistent deviations with a four-year cycle and declining volatility, we test constant drift in expected log price against an added log-age term. The procedure was fixed, validated and publicly hashed before it was applied once. Constant drift is rejected under this family at nominal 5%, and a log-age coefficient of 5.7, close to the published exponent, is not rejected. The rejection does not survive

translated_title: 无需辨识的减速：在持续性噪声下检验比特币价格的幂律趋势
translated_abstract: 将比特币价格对其创世区块以来的时间绘制在对数坐标上，价格近似落在一条直线上，因此有人提出时间上的幂律可作为其长期趋势。良好的拟合只是微弱的证据：当对趋势的偏离像随机游走一样具有持续性时，对时间的回归会在不存在趋势之处“发现”趋势和很高的R²。我们首先界定了十五年周度价格数据所能揭示的限度，然后只检验那些可以回答的问题。使用若干低频平均值——它们对噪声尺度保持不变，并针对一个事先声明的、具有四年周期和递减波动率的持续性偏离族进行校准——我们检验期望对数价格中的恒定漂移，备择假设为额外加入一个对数年龄项。该检验程序在首次应用之前即已固定、验证并公开哈希（预注册）。在该偏离族下，恒定漂移在名义5%水平上被拒绝，而对数年龄系数为5.7（接近已发表的幂指数）不被拒绝。该拒绝（结论）无法经受……（摘要原文在此截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种预先注册、对噪声尺度不变并针对四年周期性持续偏离族校准的低频检验方法，结果拒绝比特币期望对数价格的恒定漂移假说，且不拒绝约为5.7的对数年龄幂律系数，从而在持续性噪声下为比特币价格的幂律长期趋势提供了统计上可靠的首个检验。
en_tdlr: Using a pre-registered, noise-scale-invariant test with low-frequency averages calibrated over a declared family of persistent four-year-cycle deviations, the paper rejects constant drift in Bitcoin's expected log price and does not reject a log-age power-law coefficient of about 5.7, showing that good fits alone are weak evidence under persistent noise.
